purpose: Response to fixed-parameter closure changes; does not select priors or demonstrate experimental identification.
baseline_note: Every variant uses the recorded current solver and keeps all other v5 fitted and fixed coefficients unchanged apart from its listed intervention. Water-admission fraction 0.5 is an absolute setting, not necessarily half the selected baseline. The combined water/disabled-air intervention does not restore an archived model. Full specs record the kernel-loading-cap choice; these runs preserve the historical 0.3.0 startup report.
